Can you race from the sofa? A wheel stand takes about 1′10″ × 2′4″ in front of it and folds behind it after. A $139 stand and a $300 Thrustmaster T248R: $439 with the TV you have, one new outlet. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #ps5 #simracing

Couch to Track, part by part: https://roomracer.com/rigs/couch-to-track?src=yt-answer
title: Can you use a racing wheel from the sofa? A wheel stand, drawn to scale
